text:
The court should most likely apply Washington law and deny the punitive damages claim. A federal court in Washington applies Washington's choice-of-law rules, and Washington treats punitive damages as a remedy governed by forum law and bars them absent statutory authorization, so California's more permissive rule probably does not control. The main counterargument is that Washington's most-significant-relationship analysis points to California, the place of injury, which could allow the claim. I have not checked the current Washington cases on this point.

CONFIDENCE: 55
